recognition.interpretation: continuous supplied CTC path; reference sequence scored as supplied

ctc_token_roles.note: Raw vocabulary IDs precede special-token filtering; word boundaries are not acoustic silence.

rendering.mask: all positive-duration reference phones, including unvoiced consonants

separation_metadata.candidate_f0_hz: raw finite CREPE candidate before acceptance gates; diagnostic only and not vocal-F0 evidence

preprocessing.mono_policy: mono duplicated; stereo retained; selected stem mean
preprocessing.resampler: scipy.signal.resample_poly; default Kaiser 5; constant zero boundary
preprocessing.separator_normalization: whole-input mono mean/population-std; per-stem DC removed; shifts=0; split=True; overlap=0.25

separation_metadata.confidence_semantics: CREPE periodicity; not calibrated vocal probability
separation_metadata.framewise_voiced: Original confidence/source/RMS acceptance before optional temporal and local gates; not final supported F0
separation_metadata.frontend_support: 1024-sample CREPE window on resampled vocal stem
separation_metadata.gate_precision: float32 confidence; float64 source support and RMS, preserved in output diagnostics
separation_metadata.local_periodicity_semantics: Float64 2*mean(a*b)/max(mean(a*a)+mean(b*b),2*min_source_rms**2); each arm mean-centered; waveform agreement, not vocal probability
separation_metadata.local_periodicity_support: 320 half-sample symmetric pair midpoints at16kHz, arms separated by candidate period using linear interpolation; full observed support required, otherwise NaN and local_supported=0
separation_metadata.missing_f0: NaN; never encoded as acoustic silence or phonology
separation_metadata.octave_jump_semantics: adjacent supported frames differ by 1200 +/- 100 cents; not proven octave error
separation_metadata.pitch_decoder: local weighted +/-4 bins; undithered centers; no temporal smoothing
separation_metadata.qualification: not implied by extraction; see benchmark report
separation_metadata.source_rms: Exact 1024-sample selected-stem frame RMS used by the source acceptance gate; global stem DC was removed before resampling
separation_metadata.source_selection: Demucs vocals; dominant periodic pitch within that stem; no singer identity
separation_metadata.source_support_semantics: vocal/sum-of-separated-stems frame energy; heuristic, not probability
separation_metadata.voicing_rule: framewise gate, optional local waveform veto, then symmetric envelope erosion; internal available gaps up to floor(max_internal_gap_s/effective_hop_s) rows support the envelope only; final output always intersects the unfilled candidate mask

provenance.sil_policy: sil combines silence/inhalation; excluded from phone targets, not used as vocal absence

projection: Reference and decoded phone sequences omitted; numerical profiles/counts and all artifact identities retained. Original annotations/audio/native posterior artifacts remain outside Git.

protocol.crop: first16seconds from original recording start, no outcome-dependent selection
limitations: All four pairs are consumed development recordings.
Four singers/four songs and two backing recordings cannot establish generalization.
Read speech boundaries are automatically aligned and lower-grade references than manually annotated singing.
CTC evidence occupancy is not phonetic duration occupancy; TV is a diagnostic.
Model pretraining overlap has not been excluded.
Study-specific support thresholds, windows, scanner alignment, matching and neural fitting remain downstream.
Conservative mapping covers110 base phone columns vs59 large;330 large phone columns remain unmapped, including some English variants. Cross-model PER/TV confound mapping coverage with recognition.
First16seconds read versus sing contains different text extents; no matched-utterance difficulty claim.
protocol.mapping_policy: Explicit English IPA to broad NUS ARPABET; remove stress only. Diphthongs stay one phone, specified rhotic compounds expand. Multi-phone token posterior mass divided equally; not a duration estimate. Flap dx/glottal q/velar fricative kh remain distinct without NUS counterparts. All other tokens including <unk> are unmapped phones and count in PER. Blank/boundary/BOS/EOS excluded. No label-driven mapping changes after outcomes.
protocol.metrics: Free greedy CTC PER/S/D/I, raw-mass composition vs duration reference TV, ordered-bin TV and adjacent-delta error; blank/special/unmapped mass; observation/reference/mapping coverage; all missing bins retained. Descriptive only.
protocol.purpose: Reproducible32case pilot on four previously examined NUS pairs; no fresh holdout, selection or general singing-recognition qualification.
protocol.reference_policy: NUS sil combines silence/inhalation; nonphone, never vocal-absence ground truth. sp is word boundary and excluded. All other reference phones retained, including unvoiced consonants. Clip intervals to frozen input; retain partially clipped final phones; no correction based on model.

runtime.reader: soundfile float32; preserved source sample rate

protocol.terms: NUS original distribution research use only; raw files are not redistributed. Cite Duan et al., APSIPA ASC2013.

summary_aggregation: PER micro=sum edits/sum reference phones; macro=equal4singer mean; TV=mean over comparable nonmissing windows/bins (counts reported); mass coverage weighted by raw integrated phone mass. No selection or acceptance gates.
